day_of_week: Shanivaar — aaj godown maalik ke liye ABHI BECHO ka din hai. Rabi tapering phase chal rahi hai, har roz ₹22/quintal carry cost ka bojh badh raha hai. Purnea mein makka ₹1,693 — aapki khareed ₹1,850 se ₹157 neeche. Har din ki der matlab aur nuksaan.

bihar_avg.explanation:
**Bihar ka aaj ka daam:**

Bihar mandi mein makka (maize) ka aaj ka average daam ₹1,700 per quintal (yaani 100 kilo) hai. Kishanganj mandi mein 5-6 June 2026 ka data: nyunatam ₹1,650, adhiktam ₹1,825, average ₹1,700 per quintal.

**Godown maalik ke liye matlab:** Agar aapke paas 1 lakh quintal maal hai, toh aaj ki poori stock ki kimat ₹17 crore hai. 1 maheene pehle (1 May) yeh kimat ₹19.6 crore thi — mane ₹2.6 crore ka kaam gaya. Roz ₹22/quintal carry cost ke alaawa daam bhi gir raha hai.

purnea.explanation:
**Purnea (Bihar) ka spot daam:**

Purnea mandi mein aaj makka ka daam ₹1,693 per quintal hai (Bihar average ₹1,700 se ₹7 neeche — yeh normal differential hai).

**Godown maalik ke liye matlab:** 1 lakh quintal ki kimat = ₹16.93 crore. Agar ₹1,850 mein kharida tha, toh sirf purchase price par ₹1.57 crore ka nuksaan chal raha hai — carry cost ke bina. Aaj se kal tak ₹22 × 1 lakh = ₹22 lakh aur nuksaan ho jaayega carry cost mein.

indore.explanation:
**Indore (MP) ka daam:**

Indore mandi mein makka ₹1,530 per quintal (anumaan, May 20 ke ₹1,730 se decline ke aadhar par).

**Arbitrage analysis:** Indore, Bihar se ₹170 SASTA hai. Iska matlab baahar bhejna faaydemand nahi. Local Bihar mandis mein hi becho — transport cost add karne se koi fayda nahi.

all_india_avg.explanation:
**All India average:**

Poore desh ka average maize daam ₹1,780 per quintal (anumaan: Bihar ₹1,700, Indore/MP ₹1,530, Karnataka ₹1,900+ ke aadhar par).

**Godown maalik ke liye matlab:** Bihar ka daam All India average se ₹80 neeche — Bihar mein supply pressure zyada hai. Bihar mein rabi arrivals tapering phase mein hai phir bhi daam neeche hain — yeh bearish signal hai.

ncdex_maize_feed_futures.contract: NCDEX Maize Feed Industrial Grade — June 2026 (expiry 20 June 2026 ke aas-paas)
ncdex_maize_feed_futures.explanation:
**NCDEX Maize Feed Futures:**

NCDEX (National Commodity and Derivatives Exchange — yani Delhi ka bada commodities bazaar jahan agle mahine ka daam tay hota hai) Maize Feed Industrial Grade ka June 2026 contract ₹2,157 per quintal par band hua (4 June ko).

**Godown ke liye matlab:** Futures, spot (₹1,693) se ₹464 UPAR hain — yeh bahut bada gap hai. LEKIN: June contract sirf 14 din mein expire hoga (20 June ke aas-paas). Agar aap NCDEX par deliver karna chahte hain, quality grade aur delivery point (Gulabbagh) ka dhyan rakho. September contract par hedge ke liye ₹2,200+ milne ka anuman hai — lekin ₹22/din carry cost ke saath 90 din ka carry = ₹1,980 jodi, jo September price se kaafi zyada hai. NCDEX hedge yahan economical nahi.

cbot_corn_active.explanation:
**CBOT (America ka bada corn bazaar) ka haal:**

CBOT (Chicago Board of Trade — yani America ka woh bada corn futures bazaar jo poori duniya ke daam prabhavit karta hai) par July 2026 contract 418 cents/bushel chal raha hai — pichle mahine se 7.68% neeche, pichle saal se 5.54% neeche.

**Godown ke liye matlab:** CBOT gir raha hai — matlab import sasta ho sakta hai (import parity ₹2,453 par hai). Lekin desi maize abhi bhi import se ₹760 sasta hai, toh import competition ka khatara abhi nahi. CBOT ka girna ek bearish signal hai global supply ke liye.

msp.explanation:
**MSP (Minimum Support Price — sarkar ka tay kiya hua kam se kam daam, abhi ₹2,400/quintal) ka gap:**

Aaj ka Purnea daam ₹1,693 — MSP ₹2,400 se ₹707 (29.5%) neeche. Agar aapke paas 1 lakh quintal maal hai, toh MSP se mark-to-market antar ₹7.07 crore hai — lekin yaad rakho, MSP aapki laagat nahi; aapka asli fayda ya nuksaan aapki khareed ki kimat ₹1,850 par depend karta hai, jahan se aap already ₹1.57 crore minus par hain. Sarkar abhi MSP par khareed nahi kar rahi — kisan distress mein bech raha hai.

crude_oil.explanation:
**Kachcha tel (Crude Oil) ka bhav:**

WTI (West Texas Intermediate — America ka tel benchmark) $90.3/barrel, Brent (Europe/India ka benchmark) $95/barrel. 2026 ke Iran War ki wajah se — jo 28 February 2026 ko shuru hua — Hormuz Strait mein vyavdhaan hua aur oil $120 tak pahuncha tha, abhi thoda neeche aaya hai. Iran-US/Israel yuddh jari hai.

**Godown ke liye matlab:** Crude >$90 + active conflict = distilleries ke liye ethanol blending economically zaroori — maize ki demand support bana rahega. Yeh ek bullish factor hai godown maalik ke liye.

usd_inr.explanation:
**Dollar aur Rupee ka hisab:**

1 USD = ₹95.037 (5 June 2026). Rupaya pichle saal ke mukable 10.99% kamzor hua hai.

**Import parity ke liye matlab:** Kamzor rupaya matlab CBOT par imported corn India mein mehnга padega — is wajah se import parity ₹2,453 banti hai, jo desi price ₹1,693 se ₹760 zyada hai. Isliye import competition ka khatara abhi nahi — desi maal import se sasta hai.

warehouse_economics.explanation:
**Godown ki laagat ka hisab (default values ke aadhar par):**

Maana gaya khareed daam: ₹1,850/quintal (agar aapka daam alag ho toh apna daam dalo). Roz ki carrying cost: ₹22/quintal (godown kiraya ₹2-4, bank byaaj ₹15-20, fumigation+bima ₹1-2 — sab milake ₹22/din).

**Break-even:** 1 mahine ke baad ₹2,510, 2 mahine mein ₹3,170, 3 mahine mein ₹3,830.

**Aaj ka signal:** Aaj ka daam ₹1,693 — aap 1-din ke break-even ₹1,872 (= ₹1,850 + ₹22) se bhi ₹179 neeche hain. Har din ruke toh nuksaan badhta rahe ga.

**Indore-Bihar gap:** Indore ₹170 SASTA — baahar bhejna faydamand nahi.

**Import parity:** ₹2,453/quintal — desi maize ₹760 sasta (import threat nahi).

prior_day_reference.note: Koi poorv report nahi mili — default values use kiye gaye. Prior Purnea price default ₹1,900 ke mukable aaj ₹1,693 — ₹207 ki giraahat. Confidence 60% se aaj 62%. 1 May ko Gulabbagh mein ₹1,960 tha — 36 dinon mein ₹267 gira (₹7.4/din average). Yeh tapering season ki expected decline hai.

live_news_raw:
**पूर्णिया / बिहार मक्का गोदाम रिपोर्ट — 6 जून 2026 (शनिवार)**

**आज का बाजार हाल:**

बिहार में मक्का का आज का दाम ₹1,700/क्विंटल (किशनगंज मंडी, June 5-6 डेटा)। पूर्णिया का spot दाम ₹1,693/क्विंटल — 1 मई को गुलाबबाग में ₹1,960 था, मतलब 36 दिनों में ₹267 की गिरावट। यह रबी tapering season (15 May – 30 June) की सामान्य गिरावट है।

**गोदाम मालिक के लिए जरूरी हिसाब:**

अगर आपने ₹1,850/क्विंटल में मक्का खरीदा था, तो आज आप ₹157/क्विंटल के नुकसान पर बैठे हैं — सिर्फ purchase price के आधार पर। हर रोज ₹22 की carrying cost (गोदाम किराया ₹2-4 + बैंक का ब्याज ₹15-20 + fumigation और बीमा ₹1-2) और जुड़ रही है। 1 लाख क्विंटल के लिए: प्रतिदिन ₹22 लाख का carry cost।

1 दिन के बाद break-even = ₹1,850 + ₹22 = ₹1,872। आज का दाम ₹1,693 — यानी 1 दिन के break-even से भी ₹179 नीचे। हर अतिरिक्त दिन नुकसान बढ़ता जाएगा।

**NCDEX Futures और Hedging:**

NCDEX (National Commodity and Derivatives Exchange) Maize Feed Industrial Grade का June 2026 contract ₹2,157/क्विंटल पर बंद हुआ (4 जून को) — spot से ₹464 ऊपर। लेकिन June contract 20 जून के आसपास expire होगा। NCDEX के जरिये hedge करने पर September तक 90 दिन का carry = 90 × ₹22 = ₹1,980/क्विंटल — जो September price ₹2,200 से काफी ज्यादा है। इसलिए NCDEX hedge भी economical नहीं — सीधे local मंडी में बेचना बेहतर है।

**अंतर्राष्ट्रीय बाजार का असर:**

CBOT (Chicago Board of Trade — America का बड़ा corn futures bazaar) पर July 2026 contract 418 cents/bushel — पिछले महीने में 7.68% गिरावट। अमेरिका में 95.3 million एकड़ मक्का की बुआई लगभग complete है, 70% फसल अच्छी स्थिति में।

ब्राज़ील में record safrinha crop: CONAB ने 138.87 MMT का अनुमान दिया (second largest in history), USDA ने 131 MMT — दोनों में 7.87 MMT का अंतर (> 3 MMT)। USDA June 11 की अगली WASDE में Brazil को upgrade करेगा — bearish surprise का खतरा।

Argentina में 60-67 MMT का रिकॉर्ड अनुमान। Ukraine के corn exports 24.5 MMT तक बढ़ेंगे। China का import अनुमान केवल 5-6 MMT (पहले के 23.5 MMT से बहुत कम)।

Import parity calculation: CBOT 418 cents × 36.744 × USD/INR ₹95.037 = ₹1,460/क्विंटल + freight ₹175 + 50% duty = ₹2,453/क्विंटल। Domestic price ₹1,693 — import से ₹760 सस्ता। Import competition का तत्काल खतरा नहीं।

**E20 Mandate और Distillery की स्थिति:**

1 अप्रैल 2026 से E20 (20% ethanol blend) पूरे भारत में अनिवार्य है। BIS ने 15 मई को E22/E25/E27/E30 के technical standards (IS 19850:2026) भी जारी किए — E30 का actual rollout 2028-2030 में होगा।

लेकिन: देश में ethanol production capacity 19.9 billion liters तक पहुंच चुकी है, जबकि OMC की मांग सिर्फ 11 billion liters है — करीब 9 billion liter का surplus है। इसका मतलब distilleries अभी aggressively खरीद नहीं रहीं। Maize का ethanol share 45.68% है — यह structural demand जरूर है, पर surplus capacity के कारण immediate buying pressure कम है।

**कच्चा तेल और Iran युद्ध:**

28 February 2026 को शुरू हुआ Iran-US/Israel युद्ध अभी जारी है। Hormuz Strait में व्यवधान से oil $120/barrel तक गया, अब WTI $90.3 पर। Crude >$90 + active conflict = ethanol blending की आवश्यकता बनी रहती है — यह एकमात्र major bullish factor है। OPEC की demand forecast में 210,000 bpd की कटौती की गई है।

**IMD मौसम और गुणवत्ता जोखिम:**

बिहार में आज 31°C, 62% humidity, partly cloudy, हल्की बारिश और तेज हवाएं। IMD के अनुसार 17 राज्यों में भारी बारिश और 90 kmph तक हवाओं का alert। 2026 का monsoon forecast: 92% LPA (below-normal) — El Niño का खतरा। Eastern India (बिहार) को बेहतर rainfall मिलने की उम्मीद।

गोदाम में मक्का लगभग 1-2 महीने से है (रबी harvest April-May में हुई)। Quality risk: MEDIUM — जून की heat-humidity में aflatoxin (zeher) और नमी का खतरा बढ़ता है। Fumigation check करें। जल्दी बेचें।

**India-US व्यापार समझौता और DDGS:**

June 1-4, 2026 को US-India chief negotiators की 4-दिवसीय trade talks हुई। US Ambassador का कहना: '99% deal settled'। 7 February 2026 को India ने DDGS (Distillers Dried Grains with Solubles — अमेरिकी corn ethanol का byproduct जो poultry feed के रूप में उपयोग होता है) के 5 lakh tonne quota को zero/concessional duty पर allow किया था। GM status: अभी FSSAI approval pending है। जब तक GM-DDGS approved नहीं, poultry sector की maize demand stable रहेगी। DDGS approved हुआ तो 3-5% demand reduction।

**MSP gap और Warehouse Financing:**

MSP ₹2,400 (2025-26 rabi) vs spot ₹1,693 = ₹707 (29.5%) का gap। Kharif 2026 MSP ₹2,410 (₹10 बढ़ाया गया)। Sarkar abhi MSP par khareed nahi kar rahi — kisan distress mein bech raha hai.

Warehouse Receipt (WR) pledge: bank 70-80% current market value loan deta hai = ₹1,185-₹1,354/quintal। Agar naya CC limit chahiye toh WR ke zariye le sakte hain — lekin stock ki value gir rahi hai, isliye jaldi becho.

**निष्कर्ष:**

हर कोण से देखें — rabi tapering दाम दबा रही है, CBOT गिर रहा है, Brazil-Argentina में record crop है, distillery में ethanol surplus है, NCDEX hedge भी economical नहीं। केवल crude oil >$90 और E20 mandate का support है। तत्काल बिक्री ही सही रणनीति है। हर दिन की देरी = ₹22/क्विंटल carry cost PLUS दाम की और गिरावट।

news_items.title: NCDEX मक्का फीड फ्यूचर्स ₹2,157 — spot से ₹464 ऊपर — लेकिन ₹22/दिन carry cost NCDEX hedge को बेकार बनाती है
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** NCDEX (National Commodity and Derivatives Exchange — यानी दिल्ली का वो बड़ा commodities exchange जहाँ अगले महीने का दाम तय होता है) पर Maize Feed Industrial Grade का June 2026 contract ₹2,157/क्विंटल पर बंद हुआ (4 जून को)। Spot price ₹1,693 — यानी futures ₹464 ऊपर हैं। June contract 20 जून के आसपास expire होगा — केवल 14 दिन बाकी। September 2026 contract का अनुमानित दाम ₹2,200+ है।

**ISKA MATLAB KYA HAI:** ₹464 का gap बड़ा दिखता है — लेकिन carrying cost का calculation करें: June delivery के लिए 14 दिन × ₹22 = ₹308 carry. Net NCDEX margin = ₹2,157 - ₹1,850 (khareed) - ₹308 (carry) = -₹1/quintal (सिर्फ break-even)। September delivery के लिए 90 दिन × ₹22 = ₹1,980 carry. Net September = ₹2,200 - ₹1,850 - ₹1,980 = -₹1,630/quintal (भारी नुकसान)। इसलिए NCDEX hedge economical नहीं है जब carry cost ₹22/दिन हो।

**AAPKE STORED MAIZE PAR ASAR:** NCDEX पर bechne का सीधा फायदा नहीं — carry cost खा जाएगी। अगले 10 दिनों में spot price ₹1,693 से गिरकर ₹1,670 तक आ सकती है। 1 लाख क्विंटल के लिए यह ₹23 लाख का अतिरिक्त नुकसान है।

**GODOWN OPERATOR KE LIYE KAAM:**
- Agar stock hold kar rahe ho: NCDEX hedge mat karo — carry cost kamai nahi hone dega। LOCAL MANDI MEIN ABHI BECHO।
- Agar khareedna chahte ho: NCDEX ₹2,157 par sell hedge karke spot ₹1,693 par khareedna theoretically faydamand lag sakta hai — lekin carry cost match nahi hoti। Ruko।
- Hedge option: Koi NCDEX hedge economical nahi is carry cost par।

news_items.title: बिहार रबी मक्का tapering phase जारी — पूर्णिया ₹1,693 — 36 दिनों में ₹267 गिरा — हर दिन ₹22 carry cost का बोझ बढ़ रहा है
news_items.category: Bihar Rabi Arrival Status + Godown Sell Window
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** Bihar mein rabi makka ki arrivals tapering phase (15 May – 30 June) mein hain। Purnea mandi mein aaj daam ₹1,693/quintal — 1 May ke ₹1,960 se ₹267 neeche। Roz ₹7-8 ki girawat jari hai। Kisanganj mandi mein June 5-6 data: ₹1,700 average, range ₹1,650-₹1,825।

**ISKA MATLAB KYA HAI:** Tapering phase mein supply kam hoti hai — daam normally stable hone chahiye। Lekin abhi bhi girawat ho rahi hai, jiska matlab buyers ka darr zyada hai। Rabi arrivals October-November kharif season tak nahi aayenge — isliye agle 4-5 mahine mein seasonal support milna chahiye THEORETICALLY। Lekin ₹22/din carry cost ke saath 5 mahine ka hold = 150 × ₹22 = ₹3,300/quintal carry — jo kisi bhi realistic price recovery se kahin zyada hai।

**AAPKE STORED MAIZE PAR ASAR:** Agli 10 dinon mein spot price ₹1,693 se approximately ₹1,670 tak aayegi (tapering season: -₹3/din)। Carry cost 10 din mein ₹220 jodi jayegi। Net loss per quintal: ₹157 (purchase loss) + ₹220 (10-din carry) + ₹23 (price drop) = ₹400/quintal nuksaan। 1 lakh quintal ke liye: ₹4 crore का नुकसान 10 दिन में।

**GODOWN OPERATOR KE LIYE KAAM:**
- Agar stock hold kar rahe ho: KAL SUBAH MANDI MEIN BECHO। Har ek din ki der = ₹22/quintal ki extra loss।
- Agar khareedna chahte ho: Kharido MAT abhi — 15-20 din mein daam aur girenge, better entry milegi।
- Hedge option: NCDEX hedge economical nahi — spot sale karo।

news_items.title: E20 mandate 66 दिन से active — BIS ने E30 standards notify किए 15 May को — लेकिन 9 billion liter ethanol surplus है — distillery buying pressure कम
news_items.category: E20/E30 Ethanol Mandate + Distillery Demand Impact
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** 1 April 2026 se poore India mein E20 petrol (20% ethanol blend) mandatory ho gaya। BIS ne 15 May 2026 ko IS 19850:2026 notification jari ki — E22, E25, E27, E30 ke technical standards tay kiye। E30 ka actual mandate 2028-2030 tak aayega। AIDA (All India Distillers Association — yani distillery walon ki badi sanstha) ne March 2026 conclave mein E30 push ki support ki। India ki total ethanol production capacity 19.9 billion liters tak pahunchi — OMC ki maang sirf 11 billion liters — toh 8-9 billion liter ka surplus hai।

**ISKA MATLAB KYA HAI:** E20 mandatory hone se maize-based distilleries ko structural demand milti hai। Lekin SURPLUS CAPACITY ki wajah se distilleries abhi aggressively khareed nahi kar rahi — unhe maize ki zaroorat hai lekin urgency kam hai। Bihar mein 32+ grain-based ethanol plants active hain — yeh steady buyers hain, emergency buyers nahi। Maize ka ethanol allocation share 45.68% hai।

**AAPKE STORED MAIZE PAR ASAR:** E20 active hone se distillery demand ka 8-12% Bihar rabi crop absorb hona chahiye — lekin surplus capacity ke kaaran yeh support limited hai। Distilleries ₹1,700-1,750 ke range mein khareed kar sakti hain — aaj ke daam ke aas-paas। Agar distillery direct deal mile toh 10-15 din ka perspective mein ₹1,750-1,800 target milna possible hai।

**GODOWN OPERATOR KE LIYE KAAM:**
- Agar stock hold kar rahe ho: Bihar ke ethanol distilleries se SEEDHA CONTACT KARO — bulk deal ₹1,750-1,780 par milne ka chance hai।
- Agar khareedna chahte ho: Distillery buyer ban sakte ho — ₹1,693 spot mein khareed ke distillery ko ₹1,750-1,780 mein direct supply karo।
- Hedge option: Distillery forward contract sign karo 30-45 din ke liye ₹1,750 par — yeh best exit strategy hai।

news_items.title: CBOT corn 418 cents — month mein 7.68% gira — Brazil record 138.87 MMT (CONAB) vs USDA 131 MMT — import parity ₹2,453 — desi maal ₹760 sasta
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** CBOT (Chicago Board of Trade — yani America ka corn futures exchange jo poori duniya ke daam prabhavit karta hai) par July 2026 contract 418 cents/bushel chal raha hai — pichle mahine se 7.68% neeche, pichle saal se 5.54% neeche। Karan: US mein 95.3 million acres ki buai almost complete, 70% fasal achhi sthiti mein। Brazil mein CONAB ne total 2025-26 production 138.87 MMT bataya (second highest ever) — USDA ka estimate 131 MMT hai — dono mein 7.87 MMT ka antar (3 MMT se zyada — dono alag alag batana zaroori)। Argentina mein 60-67 MMT ka record। USDA ki agli WASDE 11 June ko aayegi।

**ISKA MATLAB KYA HAI:** CBOT girta hai toh global corn supply abundant hai — India ko import sasta padega। Import parity calculation: (418 cents ÷ 100) × 36.744 × ₹95.037 = ₹1,460/quintal + freight ₹175 + 50% import duty = ₹2,453/quintal। Aaj ka Bihar spot ₹1,693 — import se ₹760 SASTA। Matlab: import competition ka abhi khatara nahi — desi maal floor price ₹2,453 ke kaafi neeche hai। June 11 WASDE mein agar Brazil estimate aur badha toh — bearish surprise hoga global market mein।

**AAPKE STORED MAIZE PAR ASAR:** Global bearish signal se India mein bhi daam par dabaav. Agli 10 dinon mein ₹1,670 tak girawat expected. 1 lakh quintal ke liye ₹23 lakh ka additional mark-to-market loss। WASDE June 11 ke baad agar bearish news aayi toh ₹50-80 aur giraahat possible।

**GODOWN OPERATOR KE LIYE KAAM:**
- Agar stock hold kar rahe ho: June 11 WASDE se PEHLE BECHO — agar Brazil upgrade hua toh CBOT aur girega, India mein daam aur dabenge।
- Agar khareedna chahte ho: June 11 WASDE ke baad khareedna — agar bearish surprise aaya toh daam aur girenge, better entry milegi।
- Hedge option: Koi NCDEX hedge abhi faydemand nahi।

news_items.title: India-US trade talks June 1-4 — 99% deal settled — DDGS 5 lakh tonne quota active — GM FSSAI approval pending — approved hua toh maize demand 3-5% kam
news_items.category: India-US Trade / DDGS (GM Status + Poultry Substitution Risk)
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** India aur US ke chief negotiators ki June 1-4 ko 4-din ki trade talks hui। US Ambassador ne kaha '99% deal settled'। 7 February 2026 ke interim deal mein India ne DDGS (Distillers Dried Grains with Solubles — yani American corn se ethanol banane ke baad jo protein-rich byproduct bachta hai, jo murgi ke chaare mein maize ki jagah use hota hai) ke 5 lakh tonne ke import quota ko zero/concessional duty par allow kiya था। FSSAI ki guideline ke anusar GM origin certificate zaroori hai — woh abhi pending hai।

**ISKA MATLAB KYA HAI:** DDGS agle din GM approved ho sakta hai — trade deal finalize hone par। Jab approved hoga, poultry industry DDGS khareednegi — maize ki feed demand 3-5% tak kam ho sakti hai। India ki poultry maize demand 23.52 MMT/saal hai — 3-5% matlab 700,000-1,200,000 tonnes annual demand loss। Yeh abhi immediate nahi — pending hai — lekin risk hai।

**AAPKE STORED MAIZE PAR ASAR:** DDGS GM approval aayi toh ₹50-100/quintal ki bearish spike possible। Agli 10 dinon mein yeh news aa sakti hai — isliye ek aur reason hai ABHI bechne ka। 1 lakh quintal ke liye ₹50-100/quintal ka potential loss = ₹50-100 lakh।

**GODOWN OPERATOR KE LIYE KAAM:**
- Agar stock hold kar rahe ho: DDGS news track karo — FSSAI ki website ya agri news pe nazar rakho। News aane se pehle becho।
- Agar khareedna chahte ho: DDGS approved hone ke baad khareedna — daam aur girenge।
- Hedge option: Is risk se bachne ka ek hi tarika — jaldi becho।

news_items.title: IMD Bihar mein halki baarish-tez hawa, 62% humidity — monsoon 92% LPA — 2 mahine purana stock — quality risk MEDIUM — aflatoxin ka khatra
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** IMD (India Meteorological Department — yani India ka mausam vibhag) ke anusar aaj Bihar mein: 31°C, 62% humidity, partly cloudy, halki baarish aur tez hawa (90 kmph tak 17 rajyon mein alert)। Bihar ke northeastern districts (Purnea area) mein thunderstorm possible। 2026 monsoon forecast: 92% LPA (Long Period Average — yani normal se 8% kam) — below-normal monsoon predicted. El Nino developing. Eastern India (including Bihar) ko better rainfall milne ki umeed hai.

**ISKA MATLAB KYA HAI:** 62% humidity — yeh 70% ki critical threshold se neeche hai, isliye turant moisture risk nahi। Lekin: June-July mein Bihar mein temperature-humidity combination aflatoxin (zeher jo makka mein paida hoti hai aur poultry/human health ke liye dangerous hai) ke liye suitable hota hai। Rabi harvest April-May mein hui — stock 1-2 mahine se godown mein hai। QUALITY RISK: MEDIUM (3 mahine se kam storage, lekin season ki wajah se). Agar tez baarish hui ya godown mein chhaat se paani aaya toh moisture badhega — re-drying/re-bagging cost ₹8-15/quintal extra।

**AAPKE STORED MAIZE PAR ASAR:** Agar quality degraded hua toh: (a) buyer discount ₹50-100/quintal maang sakta hai; (b) premium market access khatam. 1 lakh quintal ke liye ₹50-100 lakh ka potential quality loss। Monsoon arrive hone par baarish mein truck/mandi logistics disrupted hogi — arrivals rukenge, daam short-term ₹10-20 bounce kar sakta hai — yeh window becho।

**GODOWN OPERATOR KE LIYE KAAM:**
- Agar stock hold kar rahe ho: Godown ki chhath/naali check karo aaj hi। Fumigation schedule update karo। Agar baarish aayi aur arrivals ruke toh ₹10-20 ka CHHOTA bounce milega — us daam par BECHO।
- Agar khareedna chahte ho: Nayi arrivals mein moisture check zaroor karo — 12-14% se zyada ho toh premium mat do।
- Hedge option: Insurance (WR-based crop insurance) review karo। WR pledge value gir rahi hai — bank CC limit review hone se pehle settle karo।

news_items.title: Iran War jari — WTI $90.3 — Hormuz Strait vyavdhaan — Brent $95 — Crude >$90 = distillery demand support, lekin $120 peak se girawat jari
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** Iran-US/Israel yuddh (jo 28 February 2026 ko shuru hua) abhi jari hai। Hormuz Strait (jahan duniya ka 20% tel guzarta hai) mein vyavdhaan hua — Iraq, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, UAE ne April mein milke 10.5 million bpd production band kiya tha। Brent crude $120/barrel tak pahuncha (war ke peak par), ab $95/barrel। WTI $90.3/barrel (Friday ko 3% gira)। US-Iran ceasefire ki umeed thodi badhi hai — isliye oil thoda neeche aaya। OPEC ne 2026 demand forecast mein 210,000 bpd ki katoti ki।

**ISKA MATLAB KYA HAI:** Crude >$90 ka matlab: ethanol blending economically zaroori hai — distilleries maize kharidti rahengi। India ke liye E20 mandate ke saath crude mahnga hona = ethanol ki urgency = maize demand support। LEKIN: Oil $120 se girakr $90 aa gaya — matlab urgency thodi kam hui। Agar ceasefire hua aur oil $70-75 par aaya toh distillery buying pressure kaafi kam ho jaayegi।

**AAPKE STORED MAIZE PAR ASAR:** Crude >$90 ek BULLISH factor hai — distillery waale maize kharidenge। Lekin yeh support fragile hai — ceasefire news se $5-10/barrel ka girna possible — jo India mein ethanol margin par pressure dalega। Yeh support ke saath bhi spot ₹1,693 hai — badhne ki jagah simit hai।

**GODOWN OPERATOR KE LIYE KAAM:**
- Agar stock hold kar rahe ho: Crude oil aur Iran ceasefire news track karo। Agar oil $80 se neeche aaya toh ₹50-80/quintal bearish signal milega। Us news se pehle BECHO।
- Agar khareedna chahte ho: Crude > $90 wali sthiti mein distillery buyers available hain — yeh reassuring hai lekin abhi entry mat karo।
- Hedge option: Crude par hedge available nahi directly — maize futures se indirect benefit karo.

news_items.title: MSP ₹2,400 vs spot ₹1,693 — ₹707 (29.5%) ka gap — sarkar khareed nahi — WR pledge value ₹1,185-₹1,354 — bank CC limit ki review ka khatra
news_items.category: MSP Gap Analysis + Warehouse Financing / WR Pledge Value
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** MSP (Minimum Support Price — yani sarkar ka tay kiya hua kam se kam daam, jo is saal 2025-26 ke liye ₹2,400/quintal hai aur kharif 2026 ke liye ₹2,410 rakhha gaya — sirf ₹10 ki badhottari) ke mukable aaj spot ₹1,693 hai — ₹707 (29.5%) neeche। Sarkar ne MSP procurement ki deadline April 30, 2026 tak extend ki thi — ab woh khatam ho chuki hai। Sarkar abhi MSP par khareed nahi kar rahi।

**ISKA MATLAB KYA HAI:** MSP ka gap ₹707 hai — matlab kisan distress mein maal bech raha hai। Aap warehouse mein ₹1,850 mein kharida maal rakh rahe hain — MSP se ₹550 neeche। WR (Warehouse Receipt — yani godown ka woh certificate jis par bank loan milta hai) ke aadhar par bank 70-80% current market value loan deta hai = ₹1,693 × 70% = ₹1,185/quintal se ₹1,693 × 80% = ₹1,354/quintal। Agar aapne ₹1,850 par loan liya tha, bank ab ₹1,185-1,354 ki limit set karega — meaning CC limit review/cut ka khatra।

**AAPKE STORED MAIZE PAR ASAR:** 1 lakh quintal ke liye: WR pledge value aaj = ₹11.85 crore to ₹13.54 crore। Agar ₹1,850 × 75% = ₹1,388 par loan liya tha = ₹13.88 crore CC limit thi — ab bank ₹13.54 crore max karega। ₹34 lakh ki margin call ya CC limit reduction possible। Yeh bank pressure ka seedha nuksaan hai.

**GODOWN OPERATOR KE LIYE KAAM:**
- Agar stock hold kar rahe ho: Bank se baat karo pehle — CC limit review se bachne ke liye jaldi becho aur loan settle karo।
- Agar khareedna chahte ho: Abhi mat kharido — WR financing ka koi major advantage nahi jab daam gir raha ho।
- Hedge option: WDRA-registered warehouse ka faayda lo — WDRA WR financing mein kuch bank better rates dete hain। Lekin jaldi settlement karo।

Lekin rabi tapering chal rahi hai, CBOT gir raha hai, Brazil-Argentina mein record crop hai, aur ₹22/din carry cost har din stock rakhne ko ghaate ka saudda banati hai. Godown maalik ke liye yeh sentiment 'thodi teji' nahi — yeh 'jaldi becho' ka signal hai.

Agar aapne ₹1,850/quintal mein kharida aur abhi 0 mahine se rakha hai (yaani aaj hi becho toh): Break-even ₹1,850. Aaj bazaar ₹1,693 hai. Aap ₹157/quintal ke nuksaan par hain.

hedge_recommendation.explanation:
**NCDEX Hedge Kyon Nahi Karna Chahiye:**

NCDEX June 2026 contract ₹2,157 par chal raha hai — spot se ₹464 upar। Lekin June contract sirf 14 din mein expire hoga. 14 din × ₹22 carry = ₹308. Net margin = ₹2,157 - ₹1,850 - ₹308 = -₹1/quintal (sirf break-even).

September contract (estimated ₹2,200) ke liye: 90 din × ₹22 = ₹1,980 carry. Net = ₹2,200 - ₹1,850 - ₹1,980 = -₹1,630/quintal (bahut bada nuksaan).

**Isliye: NCDEX hedge economical NAHI hai jab carry cost ₹22/din ho।** Local mandi mein immediately bechna zyada behtar hai। 1 lakh quintal ke liye 1,000 lots NCDEX par sell karne se bhi faayda nahi — carry cost kha jaayegi।

buyers.advice:
**Bulk khareedar ke liye advice:**

Agar aap warehouse mein makka khareedna chahte hain toh: Abhi ₹1,693 mein 20-25% khareedna theek hai (entry level). Agar 15-20 June tak daam ₹1,650-1,670 par aaya toh baaki 50% khareed lo. Final 25-30% July mein khareed lo jab kharif planting concern shuru hogi.

Break-even calculate karo: ₹1,693 khareed + 3 mahine carry (₹22 × 90 = ₹1,980) = break-even ₹3,673 — jo unrealistic hai। Isliye sirf SHORT-TERM (30-45 din) ke liye khareed karo: ₹1,693 + 45 din × ₹22 = ₹1,693 + ₹990 = ₹2,683 break-even। September NCDEX ₹2,200 se bhi neeche — short-term holding bhi mushkil hai।

**Recommendation:** Sirf distillery ya poultry ke liye DIRECT SUPPLY CONTRACT ke saath khareedna agar ₹1,750-1,800 par confirmed order mila ho। Speculative buying is time par nahi।

factors.label: tapering
factors.explanation: **Rabi Tapering Phase (15 May – 30 June):** Bihar mein rabi makka ki arrivals kam ho rahi hain — tapering phase chal rahi hai। Score -1. Daam girna jari hai despite tapering — yeh bearish hai. Agle 3-4 hafte mein supply pressure khatam hogi, lekin tab tak carry cost ₹22/din khati rahegi. Tapering mandi operator ke liye: 'Baaki jo hai, jaldi nikaalo — demand abhi bhi weak hai.'

factors.name: NCDEX Technical Signal
factors.label: neutral
factors.explanation: **NCDEX Maize Feed Futures Technical Signal: Neutral।** NCDEX par June contract ₹2,157 band hua — koi specific Buy ya Sell signal available nahi (market 4 June ko Closed tha). Neutral score = 0. Bihar mandi ke spot aur NCDEX ke beech ₹464 ka gap hai — lekin carry cost ki wajah se yeh arbitrage exploit karna mushkil hai.

factors.name: NCDEX Futures vs Spot Gap
factors.label: futures >₹50 spot se upar
factors.explanation: **NCDEX ₹2,157 vs Purnea spot ₹1,693 — ₹464 ka gap (futures >> spot ₹50 se kaafi zyada)।** Score: +2. Yeh gap batata hai ki market future mein maize ki maang zyada dekhta hai। LEKIN: Godown operator ke liye yeh gap sirf THEORETICAL hai — ₹22/din carry cost is gap ko khatam kar deti hai practical mein.

factors.name: DDGS/Import Policy Pressure
factors.label: ddgs_quota_active_gm_pending
factors.explanation: **DDGS quota active (5 lakh tonne, Feb 7, 2026) — GM approval pending।** Score: -1. India-US trade deal mein DDGS ko entry mili, lekin FSSAI ka GM-free certificate rule abhi bhi ek barrier hai। Jab bhi GM approved hogi, poultry sector mein maize ki jagah DDGS le lega — 3-5% demand loss. Yeh ek pending bearish risk hai।

factors.name: E20/E30 Mandate Window
factors.label: e20_ke_baad_30_plus_din
factors.explanation: **E20 mandate 1 April 2026 se active — aaj 66 din ho chuke hain।** Score: 0 (E20 ke baad 30+ din = 0). E30 BIS standard 15 May ko notify hua — lekin actual mandate 2028-2030 mein aayega। AIDA ne support kiya lekin extra +1 E30 approved mandate ke liye nahi diya kyunki sirf standard tay hua hai, mandate nahi। E20 active hone se structural demand hai lekin immediate urgency ka signal nahi।

factors.name: MSP Gap
factors.label: msp_se_300_plus_neeche
factors.explanation: **MSP ₹2,400 vs spot ₹1,693 — ₹707 ka gap (₹300 se kaafi zyada neeche)।** Score: -1. Yeh batata hai ki market mein supply pressure itna zyada hai ki daam MSP se 29.5% neeche hai। Kisan distress mein bech raha hai। Sarkar ne procurement deadline April 30 tak bata di aur ab khareed band kardi। Godown operator ke liye: MSP ek false comfort hai — real comparison aapki ₹1,850 ki khareed se karni chahiye।

factors.name: International Signal (CBOT + Brazil + Argentina + Ukraine)
factors.label: bearish_global
factors.explanation: **CBOT 418 cents (-7.68% mahine mein) + Brazil record 138.87 MMT (CONAB) vs USDA 131 MMT (7.87 MMT gap > 3 MMT) + Argentina 60-67 MMT record।** Score: -2. CBOT gir raha hai, Brazil aur Argentina mein record crops — global supply abundant hai. USDA agli WASDE mein Brazil ko upgrade karenge — bearish surprise ka khatra. Ukraine corn exports bhi 24.5 MMT ho rahe hain. China ka import sirf 5-6 MMT (pehle 23.5 MMT se bahut kam)। Har taraf global supply ka dabaav hai।

factors.name: IMD Bihar Mausam
factors.label: moderate_baarish_tez_hawa
factors.explanation: **Bihar mein aaj: 31°C, 62% humidity, partly cloudy, halki baarish, tez hawa (90 kmph alert 17 states mein)।** Score: +1 (moderate baarish / tez hawa). Tez baarish/hawa se arrivals thodi ruk sakti hain — chhota daam ka bounce possible. Lekin yeh short-term (1-2 din) ka effect hai। Quality risk ke liye: 62% humidity 70% threshold se neeche — aflatoxin ka zyada khatra nahi abhi। Lekin June-July mein dhyan rakhna hoga।

factors.name: Murgi/Feed Demand
factors.label: growing_demand_no_substitution
factors.explanation: **India mein poultry demand 8-10% CAGR se badh rahi hai — GM-DDGS substitution abhi pending।** Score: +1. India ki annual poultry maize demand 23.52 MMT hai — 8% badhti jai rahi hai। DDGS GM approval abhi pending hai, isliye abhi koi major substitution nahi hui। Yeh ek supporting factor hai demand side ka। FICCI-YES Bank report ke anusar 2030-31 tak total maize demand 44% badhegi।

factors.name: Pichhle 7 Din Ki Price Momentum
factors.label: 30_plus_gira
factors.explanation: **Pichle 7 dinon mein daam ₹30 se zyada gira hai।** Score: -2. 1 May ko Gulabbagh ₹1,960 tha — June 6 ko ₹1,693 — 36 dinon mein ₹267 ki girawat (₹7.4/din average). Pichle 7 din mein approximately ₹50+ ki girawat (₹1,750 range se ₹1,693 tak)। Momentum clearly bearish hai। Price decline ka trend jabtak arrivals bilkul khatam na ho, jaari rahega।

factors.name: Crude Oil / Geopolitical
factors.label: crude_above_90_active_conflict
factors.explanation: **Crude oil WTI $90.3/barrel + Iran war (28 Feb 2026 se) active।** Score: +2. Iran-US/Israel yuddh se Hormuz Strait mein vyavdhaan hua — oil $120 tak pahuncha, abhi $90.3 par। Crude >$90 ka matlab distilleries ke liye ethanol blending economically important hai — maize ki demand support bana rahega। Yeh AKELAUTA major bullish factor hai aaj ki report mein। Agar ceasefire news aayi aur oil $75-80 par aaya toh yeh factor bhi khatam ho jaayega।
